summary: Bonner County, Idaho lookout on the Kaniksu National Forest: L-4 cab on a stone base about 1938, staffed in 1937 per a newspaper item, destroyed 1966. Nothing described on site today.

facts.status_note: Destroyed in 1966; no source describes what remains at the site.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Kresek and firelookout.com date the L-4 cab to about 1938, but an August 27, 1937 newspaper item already refers to the Bee Top lookout station. The station was in use before the cab's usual date; the sources do not say whether an earlier structure stood on the summit.

sources.title: Bee Top Mtn. Fire Lookout Cabin

notes_for_editor: The 1937 newspaper item is quoted only on the Forest Lookouts page; the original was not checked. The 1938 date is repeated by three sites that share the Kresek source. Idaho Fire Lookouts credits two photos (Stan Meyers Collection; Bonner County Historical Society/Chuck Peterson collection) but gives no image URL or licence, so none were added. The brief's status gone and 1966 destroyed match the sources. Fact-check 2026-10-10: every footnoted claim was found on its cited page; Bonner County (firelookout.com) and the 1938 L-4 cab (Idaho Fire Lookouts) are now in the evidence list.
